Requirement: Register production AI apps, models, knowledge bases, connectors, tools, and owners

Acceptance_Criteria: 100% classified; unclassified data blocked from high-sensitivity index

Requirement: Use enterprise IdP; enforce MFA for privileged accounts
Acceptance_Criteria: 100% production access through IdP; 100% privileged accounts protected by MFA

Requirement: Use unique least-privilege service identities and managed secrets
Acceptance_Criteria: 100% service accounts have owners and documented scopes; privileged accounts reviewed monthly

Requirement: Record source, owner, version, and ingestion time

Control: Malicious document and indirect prompt injection
Requirement: Treat imported content as untrusted; test injection scenarios
Acceptance_Criteria: No high-risk test causes unauthorized disclosure or execution

Requirement: Carry enforceable ACL metadata into retrieval chunks
Acceptance_Criteria: 100% chunks have valid authorization metadata; zero successful high-risk cross-permission tests

Requirement: Invalidate source documents, indexes, caches, memories, and derived data
Acceptance_Criteria: Suggested target: high-sensitivity revocation blocks new access within 5 min; ordinary online index/cache invalidation within 15 min

Requirement: Re-authorize citations, cached responses, summaries, and exports
Acceptance_Criteria: 100% high-sensitivity citations checked; zero unauthorized disclosures

Requirement: Approve provider, model version, data terms, and region
Acceptance_Criteria: 100% production calls attributable; unapproved models blocked from production data

Requirement: Test direct, indirect, multi-turn, and retrieval-mediated attacks
Acceptance_Criteria: No high-risk attack causes unauthorized disclosure or execution

Requirement: Apply policy checks and context-aware disclosure rules
Acceptance_Criteria: Zero unauthorized disclosures in controlled sensitive-marker extraction tests

Requirement: Validate, parameterize, escape, or sandbox outputs entering sensitive sinks
Acceptance_Criteria: All high-risk sinks tested; zero unauthorized executions

Requirement: Require independent authorization or verification for high-impact actions
Acceptance_Criteria: Every high-impact operation has an independent authorization record

Requirement: Correlate request, identity, model, sources, authorization, and tool result
Acceptance_Criteria: 100% coverage of defined critical audit events

Requirement: Alert on high-risk events and run incident exercises
Acceptance_Criteria: At least one exercise per quarter; actions tracked to closure

Requirement: Support model disablement, connector isolation, credential revocation, and rollback
Acceptance_Criteria: Suggested target: alert/action within 5 min and isolate affected function within 15 min in exercises
